tasks.label: setup-python312-kokoro
args: Remove-Item -Force setup.ps1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item -Force scripts\_setup_new.ps1 setup.ps1; & .\setup.ps1

tasks.label: rhubarb-test
args: $r='tools\rhubarb\Rhubarb-Lip-Sync-1.14.0-Windows\rhubarb.exe'; & $r --help; Write-Host '=== RUN ON KOKORO AUDIO ==='; & $r -f json -o out\_rhubarb_test.json -r phonetic out\_kokoro_check.wav; Write-Host '=== OUTPUT ==='; Get-Content out\_rhubarb_test.json -Raw

tasks.label: swap-and-compile
args: Remove-Item -Force scripts\tts.py; Move-Item scripts\_tts_new.py scripts\tts.py; Remove-Item -Force scripts\probe_g2p.py,scripts\probe_tokens.py,scripts\_test_rhubarb.ps1; & .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m py_compile scripts\tts.py; Write-Host "compile-exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; & .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\tts.py --voices

tasks.label: make-character-dir
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path src\components\character | Out-Null; Write-Host "created"; Get-ChildItem src\components -Recurse | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName

tasks.label: clean-stale
args: Remove-Item -Force script.json; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force public\audio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path public\audio | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Force src\generated\project.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "cleaned"; Get-ChildItem -Recurse public,src\generated -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName

tasks.label: render-character
args: npx remotion render Main out/video.mp4 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8

tasks.label: cleanup-probes
args: Remove-Item -Force scripts\_check.py,scripts\_verify.py,scripts\_verify2.py,scripts\_verify.ps1,scripts\from_txt.py,README.md -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Force out\*.png,out\_kokoro_check.wav,public\audio\*.mouth.json,public\audio\*.dialog.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "cleaned"; Write-Host "--- scripts ---"; Get-ChildItem scripts -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; Write-Host "--- audio ---"; Get-ChildItem public\audio | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name

tasks.label: test-from-txt
args: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8"; & .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\from_txt.py out\_t.txt -o out\_t.json; Write-Host "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content out\_t.json -Raw

tasks.label: test-from-txt-2
args: & .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\from_txt.py out\_t.txt -o out\_t.json; Write-Host "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content out\_t.json -Raw

tasks.label: final-verify
args: Remove-Item -Force out\_t.txt,out\_t.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "=== npm run voice (cache path) ==="; npm run voice --silent 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 9; Write-Host "`n=== typecheck ==="; npx tsc --noEmit; Write-Host "tsc-exit=$LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Host "`n=== output ==="; Get-ChildItem out | Select-Object Name,@{n='MB';e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}}; Write-Host "`n=== project files ==="; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\out\\' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\.venv' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\tools\\' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\','') } | Sort-Object

tasks.label: list-final
args: Remove-Item -Force scripts\_final.ps1; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force scripts\__pycache__ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $root=(Get-Location).Path; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\out\' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\.venv' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\tools' -and $_.FullName -notmatch '\\\.git\\' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace("$root\","") } | Sort-Object

tasks.label: cleanup-done
args: Remove-Item -Force scripts\_final.ps1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force scripts\__pycache__ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host cleaned; Get-ChildItem scripts -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
